meta.title: Filson's New Cruiser Jacket Is Awesome, Even if They Lied.
meta.description:
Buy the Filson Denim Cruiser Jacket here! https://alnk.to/bEfivZd

We all know Filson makes the best BIFL wool jackets and coats (even though that price is getting pretty steep) but what do they have besides the mackinaw? WELL ILL TELL YEE. ITS DENIM. 

Filson is that brand. They make some of the best and most stylish coats and jackets around and became famous with their mackinaw wool and tin cloth cruiser jackets. Their jackets are truly buy it for life quality. However they do have some denim jackets in the same style as their cruiser! I feel like this is really a chore coat at the end of the day but with the history of the cruiser, it gets it's own category. 

So anyways, this 14.5oz raw denim jacket made in the good ol USA is ready to be reviewed.

So what do I think! Did Filson scam me?! Are they a rip off?!
